top_categories.workout_context: Gravel n Granite's Fast gravel, Rugged granite-country terrain forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 56 miles.
Gravel n Granite's australian granite-country adventure enduro rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Gravel n Granite's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before March.
When someone attacks on australian granite-country adventure enduro, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Gravel n Granite. Train it until it feels boring.
At Gravel n Granite, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Gravel n Granite, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Smooth pedaling at 56 miles saves muscle. Bad technique at mile 10 is invisible. At mile 80 it's a cramp.
56 miles on australian granite-country adventure enduro burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Base fitness for Gravel n Granite. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
2-minute all-out efforts on australian granite-country adventure enduro. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for Gravel n Granite’s 56 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum; adjust for conditions and sweat rate.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Gravel n Granite requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on australian granite-country adventure enduro to build confidence. Expect: fast gravel, rugged granite-country terrain, national park backroads.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Gravel Specific, TT Threshold, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 56 miles of australian granite-country adventure enduro in Tenterfield, New South Wales, Australia.
